notes.title: Release v1.0!
notes.notes:
We thank everyone for waiting and for being active.
Unfortunately, there were problems during the development process, and we had to spend more time than originally planned. 

We plan to continue working on this project further. 
First of all, due to the addition of free DLC, the Christmas special is already in the works.

Thanks again to everyone who supports us and is interested in the project, it is very important for us!
